01 / ABOUT

Curious by nature.
Engineer by practice.

Hi, I’m Thanugundla Sumith Reddy. I turn emerging technology into tools people can use.

My work spans AI-powered avatar generation, text-to-video systems, and conversational applications. I bring experience in research, internships, and open-source contribution to the things I build.

Beyond the code, I’ve presented at conferences and served as a Class Representative for four years. I value clear communication as much as a well-designed system.
